reversibility_triggers.decision: publish to PyPI as `amazing-binance-mcp` (ADR-0001; `binance-mcp` and `binance-mcp-server` are taken)
reversibility_triggers.trigger: the user registers the pending trusted publisher under a different free name (e.g. `trustai-binance-mcp`)
reversibility_triggers.fallback: rename dist + console script in lockstep on main before the first release; import package `binance_mcp` and tool prefix `binance_` never change

reversibility_triggers.decision: raw httpx client + in-repo HMAC/Ed25519/RSA signing (house standard), no binance-connector / binance-sdk-* dependency
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a required endpoint needs a signing or serialization quirk that costs more than a day to reproduce
reversibility_triggers.fallback: vendor the exact helper from binance-connector (MIT) into client.py with attribution; still no SDK dependency (the modular SDKs cap python <3.15)

reversibility_triggers.decision: Binance Card is a DECLARED GAP, not a task (no public REST endpoint for card spending; fiat/payments + pay/transactions are the closest proxies)
reversibility_triggers.trigger: Binance publishes a card-transactions endpoint under /sapi
reversibility_triggers.fallback: add tools/card.py as a normal wave task

reversibility_triggers.decision: Spot only in v0.1 (Spot + Wallet + Fiat + Convert + Pay + Spot Algo + Simple Earn reads); Futures / Margin out
reversibility_triggers.trigger: an algotrading strategy needs futures or margin orders
reversibility_triggers.fallback: new wave: tools/futures_*.py against fapi.binance.com behind a separate BINANCE_ALLOW_FUTURES flag

reversibility_triggers.trigger: a required client integration cannot spawn a local process (needs remote HTTP/SSE)
reversibility_triggers.fallback: add streamable-http transport behind an env flag in a minor release; stdio remains default
